# Real validation case — JAHJ19870831 macular OD

Anonymized DICOM output generated by Transducin from a real Optopol Revo FC130
`.OPT` acquisition. Data belongs to the corresponding author (Noel Jaurrieta),
who provides explicit consent for its use as a validation case.

## Files

| File | SOP Class | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dicom/JAHJ19870831_macular_OD_SR.dcm` | Comprehensive SR TID 1500 | CMT, ETDRS 9-sector, mRNFL, mGCIPL measurements |
| `dicom/JAHJ19870831_macular_OD_SLO.dcm` | OphthalmicPhotography8Bit | SLO en-face — confirms OD laterality |
| `dicom/JAHJ19870831_macular_OD_ENFACE.dcm` | OphthalmicPhotography8Bit | FNDSRECO en-face projection |

Identity tags anonymized: PatientID=`""`, PatientName=`"ANONYMOUS"`,
PatientBirthDate=`""`, PatientSex=`""`. All measurements and UIDs intact.

## Source file

The source `.OPT` file (`JAHJ19870831_macular_OD.opt`, 137 MB) is available
on Zenodo: doi:10.5281/zenodo.20031717

To reproduce the DICOM output locally:

```bash
python -m transducin.revo_opt_reader JAHJ19870831_macular_OD.opt -o output/
```

## Key measurements (SR)

- CMT: 293.0 µm (SNOMED-CT 422453003 — Foveal retinal thickness)
- ETDRS 9-sector grid: present
- Laterality: OD (ojo derecho)
- Acquisition date: 2026-02-26
- Device: Optopol Revo FC130, SOCT v21.1.2
